messages.subject: Re: Polytomous unidimensioanl IRT models
parts:
Hi Anthony

I suggest you take a look at the 'itemtype' argument of the 'mirt' function - there are several models there for dichotomous and polytomous items.

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mirt/mirt.pdf

Hope that helps.

Jake
